heading: none
name: 置中標題＋兩顆並排寬按鈕
desc: 內容全部置中：最上方可放小圖示，接著是標題，下方兩顆等寬的寬按鈕左右並排，按鈕內有小圖示與文字。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。內容全部水平置中，由上而下排列：最上方可放一個小圖示，沒有時省略；接著是標題（可多行），約佔畫面寬的四分之一；標題下方是兩顆左右並排、等寬等高的按鈕，兩顆合計約佔畫面寬的一半，每顆按鈕明顯比按鈕文字寬，也明顯比一般按鈕高；兩顆按鈕之間留明顯較寬的間隔，約為按鈕寬度的七分之一。每顆按鈕內，小圖示在左、文字在右，一起置中。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放：內容仍全部置中，兩顆按鈕仍左右並排，合計接近頁面內容寬度，之間保留間隔；每顆按鈕改為寬高相等的方形比例，約佔畫面寬的四成，小圖示移到文字上方、一起置中，按鈕文字可多行。

en.name: Centered title + two side-by-side wide buttons
en.desc: Everything is centered: an optional small icon at the top, then a title, and below it two equal-width wide buttons side by side, each containing a small icon and text.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. All content is horizontally centered and stacked from top to bottom: optionally a small icon at the top, omitted when there is none; then a title (may wrap to multiple lines) taking about a quarter of the screen width; below the title are two buttons side by side, equal in width and height, together taking about half the screen width, each noticeably wider than its button text and noticeably taller than an ordinary button; leave a clearly wider gap between the two buttons, about one-seventh of a button's width. Inside each button, a small icon sits on the left and the text on the right, centered together.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same, scaled proportionally: all content remains centered and the two buttons stay side by side, together close to the page content width, with a gap kept between them; each button becomes square in proportion (equal width and height), about forty percent of the screen width, with the small icon moved above the text and both centered, and the button text may wrap to multiple lines.

extras.name: 捲到時小圖示與標題進場
extras.prompt: 捲動到這個區塊時，最上方的小圖示與標題才出現（例如淡入），按鈕一開始就顯示。
extras.mobile: 手機保留同樣的進場效果。

en.name: Small icon and title enter on scroll
en.prompt: When the section is scrolled into view, the small icon and the title at the top appear (for example by fading in), while the buttons are visible from the start.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Mobile keeps the same entrance effect.
